text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
December ◎ | Post-Race | Wind: 
Exhilarating Fresh Breeze "My 'Castle'" 
====================

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Without straying by a tenth of a second or 
a tenth of a foot, running exactly as the 
Navigator envisioned, I have claimed the 
glory of the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
A sight of celebrating victory and sharing 
the greatest bliss. Even without a 
physical building, it was undeniably a 
castle. And so, I spoke to my beloved 
comrades.

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Looks and pedigree don't matter at all. As 
long as you have comrades, you can do 
anything. Let's make a world where 
everyone has a chance!

text_block_list.name: Tap's Logbook
text_block_list.text:
Now, whoever's reading this, it's your 
turn next. Why not head out to the open 
sea and chase a grand dream? Dancing, 
laughing, alongside your crew!
